summary: BW21_0240 records primary potency summaries for {{PRJ0040:n_compounds}} TP04 compounds and a selectivity sweep on six compounds named in the panel. Compound inventory is explicit in the primary table; plate assignment and interim membership remain in original sample-card/run records. The revised hinge core reduced off-target activity and Tervemere retained polar substituents for the next design cycle.
